replies.assert:
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class Song:
    title: str
    seconds: int

assert repr(Song("Dawn", 90)) == "Song(title='Dawn', seconds=90)"
assert Song("Dawn", 90) == Song("Dawn", 90)
